bbmp_victracker (I710ai): victracker_engine.cpp, cybertracker_6502.h and engine.h from github.com/creep-ltx/bbmp csrc/retro, commit
19d87098b3716156d80224d22dc49ca22884d1b7, unchanged (GPL-3.0-or-later, SPDX line in each file, COPYING). VIC-TRACKER (Commodore VIC-20, Daniel Kahlin,
.vt): the engine runs the tracker's own player on a 6502 with a VIC sound generator written for it.
vt_player.h is generated from musiced/player.asm + playerdata.asm of VIC-TRACKER 2.0 (BSD 3-clause, Daniel Kahlin; notice in LICENSE.victracker, which
must travel with binaries) by gen_vt_player.sh with dasm 2.20.14.1 (GPL 2, a build tool only, not shipped; the generated bytes are the player's
machine code, not dasm's). The retro:: helpers the engine uses (register_engine, field, debug_on) are in plugins/replayers/bbmp_victracker/shim.cpp.
